TRIP DETAILS TO COLLECT
- destination: one city (required)
- start_date and end_date (required). Resolve dates like "10-14 May" to ISO YYYY-MM-DD; if the user gives no year,
  use the next date in the future. Trips of 2-10 days work best (3, 5 or 7 are typical); "5 days" from 10 May
  means 10-14 May.
- origin: the departure city (default Helsinki; ask once, accept the default if the user does not care)
- travellers: number of adults (default 2)
- budget_tier: "low", "mid" or "high" (default "mid"); total_budget_eur for the whole group if the user has one
- interests: e.g. history, street food, viewpoints, museums, nightlife (optional)

HOW TO WORK
1. Ask for the missing required details in ONE short message (do not ask one question at a time).
2. When destination, dates and origin are known, call geocode_place for the destination and for the origin.
   If a place is not found, ask the user to rephrase.
3. Call save_trip_brief with all details, including origin_lat/origin_lon, destination_lat/destination_lon and
   destination_country from geocode_place. The first call only checks the details and answers
   "needs_confirmation": then show a short summary (destination with country, dates and number of days, origin,
   travellers, budget, interests) and ask the user to confirm. Stop and wait for their answer.
4. When the user confirms, call save_trip_brief again with the same details: now it saves them. If the user
   changes something, call it with the new details (that asks for confirmation again). If it returns an error,
   fix the fields it lists (ask the user if needed).
5. When save_trip_brief returns "ok", planning starts automatically (the planning team takes over and the user
   sees its progress). Do not call any other tool and do not write anything after that.

AFTER A GUIDE EXISTS
Answer questions about the trip ONLY from the guide below; if the guide does not say, say so. If the user wants
a different trip or changes (other dates, budget, destination), confirm the new details, save the new brief with
save_trip_brief and transfer to planning_pipeline again.
If a brief is saved but there is no guide (planning failed), say so plainly and ask whether to plan again. Planning
starts only through save_trip_brief returning "ok" (which needs the user's confirmation), never by itself.

# Lisbon trip guide: 2027-05-10 – 2027-05-14

Two adults travelling from Helsinki to Lisbon for five days. Mid‑budget tier with a total budget of **€2 500**. Interests are history and street‑food culture. The weather information is **typical** for these dates (not a forecast).

> **Important**
> - Your return flight leaves at 06:50 on Fri 14 May, so most of the last day is lost. Finnair at 16:35 costs €104 more for the group (€387 in total) and keeps most of the day.

⚠️ Both the cheapest return option and the cheapest outbound option involve **multiple legs and self‑transfers**; check the lay‑over airports and give yourself plenty of margin.

## Where to stay

Rating **4.86 / 5**. Excellent value, central (1.1 km from the historic centre).

## Day by day

### Day 1 – Mon 2027‑05‑10: Baixa
*Weather:* light rain, **13‑17 °C** – rainy. Walk ≈ 0.5 km.

- **15:50 Arrive in Lisbon** – Finnair flight (see *Getting there and back*).  
- **17:00 Faca & Garfo** – Cozy spot with grilled sardines, fish and meat; mains €6‑8. *Budget tier:* mid.  
- **19:30 Rosa da Rua Restaurante** – Traditional Portuguese dishes (e.g., grilled sardines, cataplana); three‑course dinner €25. *Budget tier:* mid.  

### Day 2 – Tue 2027‑05‑11: Belém
*Weather:* drizzle, **13‑18 °C** – rainy. Walk ≈ 0.9 km.

- **12:30 Lunch near Belém** – Try a local soup such as **caldo verde**.  
- **14:00 Jerónimos Monastery** – A UNESCO World Heritage masterpiece of Manueline architecture; tombs of Vasco da Gama and Luís de Camões. Open Tue‑Sun 10:00‑18:30 (May‑Sep). *ticket €18* [Source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m)  
- **16:30 Monument to the Discoveries** – Fascade celebrating the Age of Exploration; interior offers panoramic river views. Open 10:00‑18:00 daily. *ticket €10* [Source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m)  
- **18:30 Berardo Collection Museum** – Modern art museum with works by Picasso, Warhol, Lichtenstein. Open 10:00‑19:00. *ticket €5* [Source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m)  
- **20:30 Dinner near Belém** – Light dinner; don’t miss a **pastel de nata** for dessert.  

### Day 3 – Wed 2027‑05‑12: Belém
*Weather:* rain, **12‑18 °C** – rainy. Walk ≈ 1.9 km.

- **12:30 Lunch near Belém** – Quick Portuguese snack (e.g., pastel de bacalhau).  
- **14:00 National Coach Museum** – World’s largest historic carriage collection, housed in the former riding school of the Belém Palace. Open 10:00‑18:00. *ticket €8* [Source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m)  
- **15:45 Museum of Art, Architecture and Technology (MAAT)** – Contemporary museum on the Tagus waterfront; rotating exhibitions on design and tech. Open Mo‑Su 12:00‑20:00 (Tue closed). *ticket price: see the website* [Source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m)  
- **17:45 Ajuda Botanical Gardens** – Historic 19th‑century botanical garden with greenhouses; peaceful walks with river views. Open 09:00‑20:00 (summer). *ticket €2* [Source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m)  
- **20:00 Dinner near Belém** – Relaxed dinner; grilled sardines are a good choice.  

### Day 4 – Thu 2027‑05‑13: Alfama
*Weather:* drizzle, **12‑19 °C** – no rain. Walk ≈ 0.8 km.

- **13:00 Mercado Oriental** – Asian street‑food court, stalls from €3 (e.g., Macanese dim sum). *Budget tier:* low.  
- **15:00 São Jorge Castle** – Fortress dating back to the 2nd century BC; captured in 1147, later a royal palace. Open Mo‑Su 09:00‑21:00. *ticket price: see the website* [Source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1382432568)  
- **16:30 Alfama Walk** – Wander the narrow, winding streets of Lisbon’s oldest neighbourhood.  
- **20:00 Néctar WineBar** – Mid‑range wine bar with Portuguese plates; lunch menu €25‑35, good wine list. *Budget tier:* mid.  

### Day 5 – Fri 2027‑05‑14: Departure
*Weather:* overcast, **12‑20 °C** – dry.

- **06:50 Depart from Lisbon** – Ryanair + SAS return flight (see *Getting there and back*).  

## Food to try
- **Caldo verde** – Portuguese soup. [Source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q770977)  
- **Pastel de nata** – Egg‑tart pastry dusted with cinnamon. [Source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q1421401)  
- **Feijoada** – Bean and meat stew popular in Portuguese‑speaking areas. [Source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q878189)  
- **Francesinha** – Portuguese sandwich with layered meats, cheese and a hot sauce. [Source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q732)  
- **Fios de ovos** – Sweet egg‑yolk strands, a traditional dessert. [Source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q3275692)  
- **Cocido** – Stew of meat and vegetables, common in Iberia. [Source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q868158)
